mistral-nemo-minitron-8b.feature: Mistral-NeMo-Minitron-8B-Instruct is an 8-billion parameter model pruned and distilled by NVIDIA from Mistral-NeMo-12B, offering strong general instruction following, reasoning and question answering for its size. It is priced at $0.20 per million input tokens and $0.20 per million output tokens.

codegemma-7b.feature: CodeGemma-7B is a specialized variant of the Gemma model family that focuses exclusively on code generation and completion tasks. This programming-oriented model provides robust coding assistance capabilities at an affordable rate of $0.20 per million input tokens and $0.20 per million output tokens.

gemma-3-12b-it.feature: Gemma-3-12B-IT is a 12-billion parameter instruction-tuned model from Google's third-generation Gemma family, with improved reasoning, math and multilingual abilities over Gemma-2. It is priced at $0.30 per million input tokens and $0.30 per million output tokens.

granite-3.0-8b-instruct.feature: Granite-3.0-8B-Instruct is IBM's 8-billion parameter enterprise model tuned for instruction following, question answering, summarization and retrieval-augmented generation. It is priced at $0.20 per million input tokens and $0.20 per million output tokens.

mistral-7b-instruct-v0.3.feature: Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 is a fast and efficient 7-billion parameter model specifically designed for instruction-following tasks. This streamlined model provides quick response times and reliable performance at cost-effective pricing of $0.20 per million input and output tokens.
